review_scope: Governed rules and phase-aware testing governance

findings.summary: Testing review-required trigger is not deterministic.
No general durable adjudication-record schema binds finding, candidate and evidence.
Promotion does not explicitly reject TESTING to PRODUCTION.
Agent-invoked governance-validation PASS could be confused with qualification.
Testing API approval is not structurally scoped/bound.
Invalid reviewer findings are not explicitly required to remain preserved.
Shared-memory-only rule may be treated as authority after failed Git persist.

notes: This review is evidence only and does not itself change governance authority.
T-003 is already deterministically rejected by phase_policy.validate_promotion and its regression test.
T-008 is already covered by Git-first authority precedence and persistence-before-memory synchronization; shared memory is never independently authoritative.
All remaining accepted gaps require frozen tests before repair.
